nina-partnerships: Quick thread: MosaicWorks onboarding asks: can partners redistribute quantized bundles and what escrow steps for release? tagging @oliver-legal and @kevin-eng.
oliver-legal: High level: redistribution allowed only via signed addendum. We should require sha256 for weights, a derivation manifest if quantization done by SI, and a geo-restriction clause. Will draft addendum.
kevin-eng: For engineering: define download = weights + tokenizer + manifest. For bundles, require `runtime_locked=true` in manifest and signed checksum. Propose an integrity endpoint that validates manifest signature and runs 10 canonical prompts for drift smoke-test.
maya-marketing: Marketing wants hosted demo tile and co-branding guidance. Partner requests a 30-day embargo after binary handoff before public PR.
oliver-legal: I'll include embargo language plus two options: 30-day and 45-day, and an early-access path for SI customers with separate credit terms. Also add telemetry constraints (aggregate only, opt-in).
ina-partnerships: Action items: - oliver: addendum + embargo clauses (due 3410713600) - kevin: integrity endpoint spec PR (due 3410712400) - maya: draft marketplace tile copy (due 3410714800)
ops-bot: release status: integrations/onboarding-specs -> success at 3410710100
kevin-eng: noted, will include a minimal test harness in PR.
maya-marketing: please confirm embargo window by EOD Fri so comms can lock.
nina-partnerships: thanks everyone, i'll collate drafts and post one-pager to partners repo when ready.
